answer: In PoA, each bonded identity risks its escrow when it equivocates, while evidence links coordinated messages across identities. For k correlated equivocators, aggregate penalties scale quadratically, O(k^2), so a sybil controller cannot distribute blame linearly; detection also applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier, rapidly destroying collateral through asymmetric depreciation. Thus nectar, summit, and reef cannot cheaply mask coordinated fraud.
